title: The VMM must prohibit the use of cached authenticators after one day.
check_content:
Verify the VMM prohibits the use of cached authenticators after one day.

If it does not, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the VMM to prohibit the use of cached authenticators after one day.
VulnDiscussion: If cached authentication information is out of date, the validity of the authentication information may be questionable.
